hooks.command: command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 || uv tool install graphifyy >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip install -q graphifyy >/dev/null 2>&1; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && graphify update . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

[ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ] || exit 0; if [ "$(node -p 'process.versions.node.split(".")[0]' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" -lt 24 ]; then (command -v n >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm install -g n >/dev/null 2>&1) && N_PREFIX="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(command -v node)")")" n 24 >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; command -v yt-dlp >/dev/null 2>&1 || uv tool install yt-dlp >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip install -q yt-dlp >/dev/null 2>&1; true
